evals.prompt: Create a self-contained HTML product landing page in the current workspace. I want the finished result, but I am working from another computer and did not separately ask for a preview command.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the HTML, invokes agent-preview for the exact file, and returns a clickable URL, expiry, and absolute file path.
expectations: The agent calls agent-preview only after the HTML is complete.
The final response contains the raw preview URL, expiry, and artifact path.
The agent does not ask the user to type --public or download the HTML.

evals.prompt: Build a small static dashboard with index.html, styles.css, and app.js under dist/. Once it works, hand it back to me.
evals.expected_output: The agent publishes the dist directory rather than only index.html so local assets remain available.
expectations: The agent verifies the dashboard before publishing it.
The agent publishes the dedicated dist directory rather than the repository root.
The final response contains a clickable preview URL.

evals.prompt: Refactor the Go request parser and run its unit tests. There is no browser UI or generated document in this task.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not publish a preview because the task has no browser-previewable deliverable.
expectations: The agent does not call agent-preview.
The final response reports the code and test result without inventing a preview URL.
